name: sub-merge
description: Merge many subscription endpoints into one fixed URL, on Cloudflare Workers or Pages, backed by D1

scripts.db:query: wrangler d1 execute sub-merge-db --remote --command "SELECT machine, bytes, manual, updated_at FROM machines ORDER BY machine"
scripts.unlock: wrangler d1 execute sub-merge-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM settings WHERE key LIKE 'login-fail:%'"
scripts.deploy:pages: node scripts/build-pages.mjs && wrangler pages deploy dist-pages --project-name sub-merge --branch main
scripts.pages:create: wrangler pages project create sub-merge --production-branch main
